key_insight: PortalEvent structures patient portal communication into 8 event types and 71 roles to characterize message content and potentially missing details.
clinical_relevance: This representation could support tools that identify information gaps in patient messages and help reduce clarification exchanges and clinician workload.
method: Combined literature review with LLM-assisted ontology induction.
Refined the schema through iterative review with clinical NLP researchers and three clinicians.
Evaluated real portal messages and clinician follow-up questions, with manual verification of random samples.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covered 10,000 patient messages and 57,321 clinician follow-up questions; the abstract reports average detection precision of at least 0.90, but its final result is truncated.
watch_item: Validation came from one health system, and improved workflow efficiency or patient outcomes were not demonstrated in the provided abstract.
paper_title: PortalEvent: An Event-Based Ontology for Patient-Initiated Portal Communication
